thread:
liz-m: heads up — noticed compact actor-picker is lagging badly for orgs >10k members. opening the role assigner hangs the UI for ~800ms before first paint. attached a HAR and a gif. :grimacing:

anand: can repro on staging with a seeded org. seems to be rendering ~10k DOM nodes in the list when the compact mode should show 40 visible rows and virtualize the rest. suspect our virtualization sentinel isn’t wired for the compact density variant.

katie: ah — we added compact mode last quarter and used the same <MemberList/> without passing virtualization props. quick fix might be to swap to `react-window` with fixed row height.

sam: curious about telemetry too — we don't have metrics for rendered node count or first-paint for the actor picker specifically. makes it hard to know scope across customers.

liz-m: exactly. I think we should add two quick telemetry events: `actor_picker.open` with {org_size, visible_count, total_rendered} and `actor_picker.render_chunk` for incremental rendering timing.

anand: agreed. patch plan: 1) enable virtualization for compact variant, 2) lazy-load avatar badges + presence, 3) emit telemetry, 4) canary behind FF to 5% orgs >5k.

katie: implementation note — avatars are currently inline img tags which block layout. We can replace with a lightweight SVG placeholder and swap in avatar src via `srcset` lazy load. avoids layout thrash.

sam: for rollout, add a `picker.virtualization.v1` feature flag (config service) and create a telemetry dashboard: count of `actor_picker.open` by org_size bucket, median TTFP, % where total_rendered > visible_count*2.

liz-m: who wants to own the dashboard? I can draft the dashboard query for NewRelic and Grafana panels tomorrow.

anand: I’ll open the PR for virtualization + lazy avatars. will include a short perf test harness in the component stories to simulate 50k members.

sam: add a sampling key to telemetry (sample_rate) — don't want to overload analytics for huge orgs. maybe sample 1% by default and 10% when org_size > 20k.

katie: also add a fallback UX — if first paint >1s show skeleton with message “Loading members… (this will not block role assignment)”. that reduces perceived slowness and avoids accidental repeated clicks.

deploy-bot: deploy queued — will run canary rollout to 5% once PR is merged and feature flag is on. :rocket: (ETA next deploy window)
